No, you can't. This card is only treated as [Ballistamon] for a DigiXros.
                                            
                        Related Cards
Card Q&A.q: Can I use  on a Digimon such as BT10-013 [Shoutmon X5] that has [Ballistamon] in its DigiXros requirements to place this card under a Tamer?

Effect: This card is also treated as [Ballistamon] for DigiXros.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon can't be returned to hands or decks by your opponent's effects and gets +3000 DP.
[On Deletion] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] This Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait gains ＜Blocker＞.
